additional_info.subject: ID0382666-DC/Si-D/HU[ZQZawY] - FW cannot be updated CRM:00315001866
additional_info.body:
Hi Norbert,
After today's assistance from L3, we were able to bring the charger to v5.0.21.
After the update we were faced with Failsafemode_Active. After checking the WebUI, the Router 2 was not updated correctly and must be the reason why the charger doesn't recognize the router even if it's on the network and we are able to access it with password.
After performing a factory reset via command line, the router is updated and charger is fully operational.
As you requested, I will keep the ticket open until Monday to confirm that nothing is wrong.
Have a nice weekend and thanks for the help!
Best regards,
Francisco
